Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm
Yamaha C5 grand piano recordings
https://sfzinstruments.github.io/pianos/salamander/

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

This app bundles a subset of the MP3 files distributed by Tone.js.
https://github.com/Tonejs/Tone.js/blob/dev/examples/sampler.html
The app adjusts playback rate and applies a gain envelope at runtime.
